basic_info.description: Welcome to 326 Eureka St, an exquisite sanctuary nestled in the heart of vibrant San Francisco. This elegant lower-flat residence, elevated above street level, offers a harmonious blend of timeless charm and modern convenience within its 836 square feet. Upon entering this high-ceiling home, you'll be captivated by the sophisticated flow of the living spaces, accentuated by an original pocket door that adds a touch of historical allure. The spacious bedroom boasts a custom wardrobe, ensuring ample storage while maintaining a sleek and uncluttered aesthetic.  Open kitchen with plenty of kitchen cabinets lead to the very private dining room that you step outside to a very private balcony, a tranquil retreat perfect for savoring morning coffee or evening reflections. The expansive shared backyard invites leisurely afternoons, surrounded by lush greenery.  Practicality meets elegance with exclusive use of a generous storage space in the basement, along with convenient shared laundry facilities. This home can be optionally set up as a 2 bedroom flat, and it offers a seamless blend of privacy and community, providing a serene escape in the midst of city life (walk to both the Castro and Noe Valley).  Experience refined living - a residence that truly embodies elegance and charm.
